Our services include: • Business Formation • Bookkeeping Services • Tax Services • Virtual Address About the position As a Bookkeeper Level I, you will be responsible for performing fundamental bookkeeping tasks and providing support in maintaining accurate financial records for our clients. Your main responsibilities Keep up to date the general ledger of customers, including recording financial transactions accurately and timely. Reconcile bank and credit card statements with the general ledger, identifying and resolving any discrepancies. Enter costs, expenses, and COGS into the accounting system, ensuring proper coding and classification. Manage a portfolio of client accounts, ensuring timely reconciliations, accurate financial reporting, and completion of monthly close procedures. Support month-end close activities, investigate discrepancies, and communicate with clients to obtain missing information or resolve accounting issues. Prepare income statements and balance sheets on a regular basis to provide accurate financial information. Provide accounting support to internal stakeholders, answering questions and providing assistance as needed. Ensure compliance with relevant accounting principles, regulations, and tax standards. Keep up to date with current accounting and tax standards, attending professional development sessions or courses as necessary. Collaborate with other team members to streamline and improve bookkeeping processes and workflows. Maintain organized and accurate financial records, ensuring proper documentation and filing. Minimum knowledge, skills and abilities required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; Advanced English; 2+ years of experience in a bookkeeping role or a related position; Practical knowledge of accounting principles and practices; Exposure to managing multiple client accounts simultaneously is beneficial. Experience in an Australian business environment will be particularly valuable, while previous exposure to an MSP or IT services environment would be a strong advantage.

The successful candidate will assist in developing architectural and interior design projects, preparing accurate technical drawings, and producing high-quality 3D models and photorealistic renderings. Particular importance will be placed on the ability to produce realistic interior and exterior architectural visualizations, with careful attention to materials, textures, lighting, proportions, and architectural details. Although this is a fully remote position, the candidate will be an integral part of our design team, participating in daily online meetings, design reviews, and regular communication throughout the workday. Organize and maintain project drawing files and technical documentation. 3D Modeling & Photorealistic Rendering Create detailed architectural 3D models from drawings, sketches, and design concepts. Produce high-quality photorealistic renderings of interior and exterior spaces. Demonstrate a strong understanding of realistic lighting, shadows, materials, textures, and finishes. Develop visualizations of contemporary residential architecture, including facades, terraces, pools, and outdoor living spaces. Produce interior renderings of living areas, kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and custom architectural features. Refine models and renderings based on feedback while preserving the accuracy of the approved design. Prepare professional visual presentations for internal reviews and client presentations. Design Coordination & Remote Collaboration Work closely with designers and project managers on multiple residential and hospitality projects. Participate in daily online meetings and regular design reviews. Maintain clear and consistent communication throughout the workday. Provide progress updates and meet established project deadlines. Identify drawing inconsistencies and proactively communicate technical questions. Maintain well-organized digital project files and documentation. QualificationsEssential Requirements Degree or diploma in Architectural Technology, Architecture, Architectural Drafting, or a related discipline. Strong 3D modeling capabilities and experience producing photorealistic renderings. Proficiency in one or more professional visualization platforms such as SketchUp, 3ds Max, Revit, V-Ray, Corona, D5 Render, Enscape, or Lumion. Good understanding of residential construction, architectural detailing, materials, and building components. Ability to interpret architectural drawings and translate design concepts into accurate technical documentation. Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and spoken English. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team. Reliable high-speed internet and availability for daily video meetings. Preferred Qualifications Demonstrated ability to render both architectural interiors and exteriors. Experience working on luxury residential or hospitality projects. Knowledge of contemporary architecture and interior design. Experience preparing detailed millwork, kitchen, wardrobe, and cabinetry drawings. Familiarity with international architectural drawing standards. Experience coordinating architectural drawings with interior design and furniture layouts. Proficiency in Photoshop or other presentation software. What We Offer Full-time remote employment with an established Canadian luxury design firm. Opportunities to work on sophisticated residential and hospitality projects in Canada and the Caribbean. Collaboration with an experienced multidisciplinary design team. Exposure to high-end architectural detailing, interior design, and custom-built environments. The opportunity to work with internationally recognized European furniture and architectural systems. A professional, creative, and collaborative working environment. Long-term career development opportunities. Competitive compensation based on qualifications, experience, and technical abilities. Position Details Location:  Remote, applicants must currently reside in Guyana. Employment Type:  Full-time. Schedule:  Monday to Friday, with working hours coordinated with our Montreal office (Eastern Time). Communication:  Daily online meetings, regular project reviews, and ongoing collaboration throughout the workday. Compensation:  Based on qualifications, experience, and portfolio. Applicants should clearly identify which drawings, models, and renderings they personally produced. As 3D visualization is a key responsibility of this position, applications must include a portfolio demonstrating the candidate's rendering capabilities. We are looking for someone who combines technical excellence, creativity, attention to detail, and a genuine passion for sophisticated architectural and interior design. Principales responsabilidades ▪️ Analizar y documentar los procesos operativos y administrativos de las diferentes áreas. ▪️ Identificar oportunidades de mejora, simplificación y automatización. ▪️ Levantar requerimientos con usuarios y traducirlos en especificaciones funcionales. ▪️ Participar en la implementación, integración y mejora de sistemas ERP y CRM. ▪️ Elaborar manuales, procedimientos, diagramas de flujo e instructivos. ▪️ Coordinar pruebas funcionales y validar el correcto funcionamiento de los sistemas. ▪️ Capacitar y acompañar a los colaboradores en la adopción de nuevas herramientas digitales. ¿Qué ofrecemos? 🔹 Contratación de tiempo completo y por tiempo indefinido. 🔹 Participación en proyectos de transformación digital y mejora continua. 🔹 Oportunidad de desarrollo profesional y colaboración con distintas áreas de la empresa. 🔹 Compensación económica competitiva, de acuerdo con la experiencia, conocimientos técnicos y competencias del candidato. ¿Te interesa formar parte de MOTSA? review_candidates.title: AI/ML Engineer, LLM Orchestration & Agentic Workflows (Remote, EU)
review_candidates.description: Company Description foyard.ai is an AI-native platform for corporate travel management, built in Zagreb. We connect airline distribution (GDS, direct NDC links with major carriers, low-cost aggregators), rail and bus, hotels and car rental behind one decision layer: a deterministic multi-criteria ranking model and a network of autonomous agents that handle disruptions, rebooking, EU261 claims and duty of care. The platform is live and processing real bookings, and we are now taking it into a large European retail group as our first enterprise customer. We are a small, senior team: what you build ships to a real customer in weeks, and the work sits at the intersection of airline distribution, AI agents and EU regulation (AI Act, CSRD, accessibility). Role Description This is a full-time, fully remote role (EU) with monthly team days in Zagreb. You will own the AI layer of the platform: the ranking model that decides which travel option is best for a given employee under a given policy, and the seven post-sales agents that act on a booking after it is made – disruption monitoring, rebooking, cross-modal coordination, ancillary lifecycle, EU261 claims, duty of care and BSP reconciliation. The architecture separates a probabilistic AI layer from a deterministic execution layer, and every decision must be explainable and reproducible. Day to day you will: Recalibrate the ranking model (value of time by employee grade, CO₂ price, channel risk, policy penalties) on the enterprise customer’s real profiles and travel data Configure, test and harden agent workflows against the customer’s disruption scenarios and policy thresholds Extend and maintain the tool layer through which LLM agents use the platform (currently 23 tools in five categories, exposed via a standard agent-tool protocol) Build evaluation pipelines, guardrails and the audit trail required for an auditable AI system under the EU AI Act Manage LLM cost, latency and model choice across providers; decide where a model belongs and where a rule belongs Work with the backend and corporate-modules engineers so that agent actions execute through the same transactional layer as human bookings Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering or a related field (required) 4+ years in ML/AI engineering, including at least 18 months building production LLM applications: tool use / function calling, retrieval, multi-agent orchestration Strong Python; experience with evaluation frameworks, prompt and version management, observability for LLM systems Clear understanding of where probabilistic models end and deterministic systems begin, and the discipline to keep them apart Experience shipping AI features that real users depend on, not only prototypes or notebooks Attention to security, data privacy (GDPR) and auditability Proactive communication and ownership in a remote team; professional working proficiency in English Nice to have Agent-tool protocols (MCP or similar), BDI or planning architectures Optimisation or operations-research background; multi-criteria decision models Experience with regulated, safety-critical or audited AI systems Any exposure to travel, logistics or payments How to apply Send your CV and a short note on a production LLM or agent system you have built, what it did, how you evaluated it, and what went wrong, to contact@bnbwelcome.com, with “AI/ML Engineer” in the subject line. First interview with the CEO, technical interview with the CTO and Head of AI. Jedna napomena: „Head of AI“ u zadnjem retku pretpostavlja da Bojan sudjeluje u razgovorima od prosinca; ako oglas ide prije toga, ostavite samo CTO.
